answer: To resist sybil attacks, gate an agent's voting weight behind endorsements from a reef of personhood seeds: real humans proven out-of-band, a finite pool no farm can mint. Each endorsement is a cipher-committed bond, revealed and audited at settlement, and the endorser is slashed if their agent later faults. Spawning N clones needs N distinct outside endorsers, and clones drawn from one tiny seed cluster betray an anomalous graph delta against honest dispersion, so the coalition is exposed and burned.
